rule: Each entry maps an accepted input spelling to its canonical word. Applied as an exact-match substitution before any fuzzy correction (spec §10.1), and before the retired-words table (§10.2). Encoders never emit a variant. Every target is a list word or a retired word; no variant is a list word. Additive; versioned with the overlay.

notes.meter: one edit from both 'metre' (its variant) and 'meteor' (a different list word); the table runs first so it resolves to 'metre'.
notes.donut, omelet, checker: two or more edits from their canonical words, beyond fuzzy correction; only the table resolves them.
notes.caliber: the American spelling of 'calibre', which wordlist 1.1.0 retired (replaced at its index by 'diagram'). The variant is applied first and the retired-words table second, so a name written 'caliber' still resolves to the same square.
